description.value: Tugboat Annie's Pub & Grille is a family-operated waterfront pub at Shelter Island Marina in East Richmond, open since 1986 and run by the McPhail family ever since. Perched steps from the Fraser River, it offers a renovated patio with river views and a classic maritime atmosphere. The venue is adult-only (19+) and includes an attached liquor store alongside its full pub and grille menu.
